lines.en: My six legs carry me steadily.
My red shell gleams in the dark.

lines.zh: 岩浆在下头亮，我走在上头。
lines.en: Lava glows below; I walk along the top.
I skirt a patch of lava.
My antennae test the heat ahead.

lines.zh: 热风里有喘气，我改了方向。
lines.en: Breathing rides the hot wind; I change course.
My mandibles open and close.
I come out of a crack.
I have built here.
I go straight, without detours.
A few follow behind me.
I leave my scent on the rock.
I climb up the rock face.

lines.zh: 我从一块浮石跳到另一块
lines.en: I hop from one floatstone to the next.
I make one circuit along the nest wall.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在前后各一只
lines.en: Companions flank me front and back.
I stand at my own nest mouth.
My mandibles do not relax.
I watch the movement below the rock face.
Heat passes over my back.
Everything here is hot.
I count what passes.
I do not need to breathe hard.
I touch a companion's antenna.
Some sounds come from the nest.
I wait for them to come out.

lines.zh: 我在巢口来回走了两步
lines.en: I pace two steps at the nest mouth.
I raise my antennae higher.
You are standing before my nest.
I raise my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我认得活物的味道，下界巢里全是。
lines.en: I know the smell of the living; it fills my Nether nest.

lines.zh: 你站在我的巢前面，前足抬起来了。
lines.en: You stand before my nest; my foreleg is raised.
My forelegs have lifted.
This is only a reminder.
This whole area is mine.
I do not like waiting.
My mandibles stay open.

lines.zh: 巢口的岩缝里还有十只。
lines.en: Ten more wait in the crevice at my nest mouth.
A crack in my shell.
I step back, mandibles still open.

lines.zh: 甲裂到腹节，我照样张颚。
lines.en: The crack reaches my abdomen; my mandibles still open.
I flip over, and back.
I made no sound.
My mandibles still work.
My companions are closing in around me.

lines.zh: 同伴用触角敲我的甲，问伤。
lines.en: A nestmate taps my shell, asking if I am hurt.
This wound is no matter.
I will pay it back.
Blood is still dripping from your hand.
I turn your way.
Not enough to share with the nest.
I extend my mandibles.
I guard the Nether ant nest.
I smell blood.
Do not pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 下界的热气把我的味道吹过去。
lines.en: Nether heat carries my scent toward you.
The rock face blocks your retreat.
I will take this.
You struck my red shell.
I did not give a step.
My mandibles nearly caught you.
You cracked stone as you backed away.
We are pressed too tight.
The hot wind pushed us together.
I am against your boot.
That bump does not count.
Move; this is my road.
Do not block the nest entrance.
We speak with our antennae.
The nest is dug.
You watch this side.
I go down to check the other.
These rock layers are warm enough.
We put the eggs inside.
Do not let the heat out.
We take turns outside.
This stretch is ours.
Quieter still.
I grip it with my mandibles.
It is bigger than my body.
I carry it on my back.
It is far too hot.
I drag it to the nest mouth.
I cannot swallow this.

lines.zh: 我的巢口，冒着下界热气。
lines.en: Heat rises from my nest mouth.
The colony can use this.
I can carry this.
Set it by the nest mouth.
My eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 我在下界筑巢，红得显眼。
lines.en: I nest in the Nether, red and plain.
My companions circle behind.
You have only one way out.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别的东西可吃
lines.en: There is nothing else to eat here.
I stand before the nest, and will not yield.
You stepped on my scent trail.
My red shell is gleaming.
Then let us start.
Retreating is too late.
I act on the third count.
Shouting your throat out is useless.
I follow the scent trail after you.
My antennae turn wherever you go.
I go up the rock face.

lines.zh: 从下界巢顶爬下来更快。
lines.en: Climbing down from the Nether nest is faster.
My companions are behind you.

lines.zh: 你前面的路被岩浆截断
lines.en: Lava cuts off the road ahead.
I close in step by step.
You are already sweating.
The heat favours me.
My shell does not mind heat.

lines.zh: 我也在找，找更好的角度
lines.en: I am looking too, for a better angle.
I work around the flank.

lines.zh: 下界筑巢的红蚁，牙很硬。
lines.en: A Nether-nesting red ant with hard jaws.
My mandibles clamp tight.
I climb up your boot.
This will ache for a while.
I bite at your armour's seam.
My companions have arrived.
I pull back and reposition.
That was worth it.

lines.zh: 我的颚上还挂着你的布。
lines.en: Your cloth still hangs from my mandibles.
This bite went deeper.

lines.zh: 我从下界的岩缝里爬出来，红甲发亮。
lines.en: I crawl out of a nether crevice, red shell shining.
My red shell stands out.
One companion after another follows.
This is my nest mouth.
Heat rises from below.
I know this area well.
There is the smell of something living ahead.
I turned that way.
I have opened my mandibles.
I have come to this side.
My shell burns brighter red.
I fall from the rock face.

lines.zh: 水在这里很稀奇，也很难受
lines.en: Water is rare here, and painful.
The blast throws me against the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 一根东西扎进我的甲缝
lines.en: Something sticks in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我的颚发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my mandibles.
The nest has no stores left.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的甲噼啪响
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my shell crackles.
There is no rock face to climb.
